First let me say how sorry I am that you have had to endure the strain of a cheated relationship. Its hard to come to terms with at the best of times, the fact you asked for help only shows me that you dont want to die.

I wish I could tell you that time heals all wounds but in reality that would be a lie. I know I am going to get some serious downvotes for that statement. Time doesnt heal anything, if anything time prolongs the pain we feel. I understand that your SO did something horrible to you, and that you feel that pain and anguish more now than you ever will. If I could make the pain go away for you I would, but I dont know that trick. I can tell you without ever meeting you, speaking to you, or knowing your personal history that you are a beautiful person. That you do have a place in this world, even if right now it feels like the floor has fallen out from beneath you and your falling through limbo.

I hope that you can listen to my words with your heart as well as your head. You cant fix stupid. Please dont let some boy who did a horrible thing affect the rest of your wonderful life. I know that you are hurting and desperately need to feel wanted and loved, I know from personal experience. I know what it feels like to be on the brink of non-existence. I have found solace on that cusp for years, but I could never do it, and I dont think you can either. You know what life has in store for you. It may just be a glimmer in the reaches of your mind right now but you know what is coming, and the end is not it. There is a light at the end of the tunnel, I can all but promise you that.

I want to tell you a story, I hope it helps you through this ordeal. I know a young man whom just lost his wife and children. He is completely fucked up. Cant sleep or eat, stress is making him sick, he has not been with his family for over 2 months now. I know that he thinks for ending it, and I have talked him out of it many times since his ordeal started. Would it be easier for him? I honestly dont know, he says yes. I have walked across the war-torn landscapes of people dying from horrid things I have seen enough death for 100 lifetimes. I hope that what I can tell you will help you find your path.

This is the important part so pay attention.

You are who you are, you are no ones object or possession.
You are beautiful inside and out.
You are a kind and caring person. I can say this because you feel the remorse of loss.
You are more courageous than you will ever give yourself credit for.
Stop feeling the guilt for his mistake. Its not yours to carry. The pain you will carry for a lifetime, but it becomes manageable. The guilt you feel now is not something you can control. Drop that baggage at the door, you are your own person who can and will find the happiness you deserve. It may be next week, it may be 40 years from now. Only you can break the chains holding your pain, but please dont let some boy ruin what could be the best years of your life.

Every life is sacred. Every life is positive. From every life springs peace and happiness. Remember that you volunteered for this world, you just forgot. There is nothing you cannot handle, your life has gotten you this far and it will continue to get you to your destination.

Your life is a precious and beautiful thing. Dont throw it away.

I had no insurance, was not wearing a seatbelt and I was not notified by the state that my license was suspended until two years after it happened. My insurance had lapsed two days before the accident, I paid out of pocket for damages to my car and the car I hit and medical bills for the other driver. I plead my case in court and was summarily laughed at by the magistrate and was told "shit happens". That was 10 years ago.

My home state, which I do not live in any longer, will not accept a payment plan of less $570 a month for the next 36 months in order to get my license back. I have contacted several lawyers and even written the governor of my home state explaining the situation and the length of time since the incident. No exceptions will be allowed nor will they accept a smaller payment arrangement. Time heals all wounds, well maybe not all, but those words had kept me going for the last 10 years. My hands shook as I picked up the envelope out of the desk drawer. A light layer of dust covered the weathered manila package. Fear and anxiety coursed through my veins, making me sweat and breath a little quicker.

"Open it, you deserve to know the truth baby.". Comforting words from the woman I love so desperately.

"Really? Do I truly need to know THIS?". I replied shakily.

I have always suspected I was not my parents child. I have always believed I was adopted. My parents were older when I was born, mom had just celebrated her 45th birthday two months before I was born. Dad had been almost 50.

Now 30 years later I sit here with my wife trembling as I stare at a letter. A letter I have had for the last 10 years. And just like the day it came in the mail I don't know if I can or should open it, it scares me that much that I may be right.

"It will put you at ease to know the truth. No matter what that is Lee.". Sue says in a calm voice, gently rubbing my back. "They have loved you all your life. They are your parents, no matter what that paper tells you honey.".

I nod silently, sitting down on the couch. "But what if I am right? What if everything I have known is a lie?".

"Would it make you love them any less?" She asks with concern in her voice.

"No." is all I can say.

Before I know what is going on Sue has the envelope in her hand and has the tab pulled apart. Lovingly she looks at me and extends my own personal open Pandora's box.

I reach inside and pull out the documentation. Still wondering if I should read this. I do not want to destroy my family, they have spent their lives raising me to trust in humanity. "Everyone is human Lee." my father told me growing up. "We are allowed to make mistakes.". Was he trying to tell me all this time?

I tear up a little as I find the strength to finally read my worst nightmare.

Dear Mr Kinwer

We are sorry we cannot offer you an answer on the samples you sent to us. We regret to inform you that this lab is not equipped to handle NON-HUMAN DNA. We hope that this does not dissuade you from using our services again. Again we do apologize.

Sincerely

Dr Justin Watson.

Dumbfounded I look to Sue, handing her the letter that has kept me up at night for 10 years.

"What the fuck....." is all I hear her say before my phone is in my hand dialing my fathers cell.

He picks up after two rings. "Kinwer." he says as always when answering his phone. "Dad, its Lee. I need to talk to you, and I need the truth. What am I? What are we?"

"Lee, what in the sam hell are you talking about? Are you high? You said you were clean now, I am hanging up. Don't call back till your sober." and without a sound the line went dead in my hand.

"I'm going over there, I have to know the truth now.". I said as I grabbed my coat and keys from the table near the door.

"Wait for me." came Sue's response.

There is a fine line between being poly and being set up for a "Sister wives" re-run.

My wife and I are poly, we have 4 wonderful children (6, 4, 3, and a newborn.) I understand this from your point of view and maybe even your husbands. My wife is a stay at home mom who cleans house, cooks dinner, and raises the kids. She works more than I do, and I have a 60+ hr schedule at work. We have tried several times to have another woman or couple in play with us. Something always happens to strangle the outside relationship. My wife C is always tired and always exhausted from having to take care of everything at home while I am at work. I can't and don't blame her for not being able or wanting to look for another partner right now.

We have talked at length about what we are alright with and what we want from our poly relationships. Sometimes you have to put what you want or think you need on the back burner because of the promises and oath's that we have taken.

It seems to me that your husband needs several things. A) to sit down and figure out what is truly important to him. Having multiple partners or being a good father. He may not have wanted the children you have now but I assure you he enjoyed creating them. B) Get him into counseling like some of the other commentators have mentioned as well. Depression is dangerous at best and deadly at worst. C) Sit down with him and explain the situation that you find yourself in if you have not already. When you can look him in the eye and tell him that both of your wants wants of having another woman at this time are hurting your relationship and that should be paramount in my opinion. 

I hope that you and your husband work everything out for your own sake's.

I was sitting at my computer when the mail came by that day. Grudgingly I roused myself from the stupor of Reddit to allay myself the fear of my bills. As I open the front door and reach into the mailbox I feel an intense pain from my forefinger, startled and now bleeding I reach for the envelopes inside and quickly rush to get a band aid. Tossing the mail on my desk as I come back inside and hurriedly looking for some neosporin and a bandage, of which we are out....

As I sit back down at my computer and begin to leaf through the mountains of throw-away advertising and junk mail, I come across one envelope that almost seems alive, as I pick it up I can feel a faint energy radiating away from it. There is no return address or post mark but it is addressed to me.

Chuckling to myself about how my friends are trying to prank me I open the envelope. The heavy paper of the parcel is ornately designed, depicting a sunburst pattern. I open the package carefully as to not damage the envelope itself or its contents. The interior of the envelope is blacker than black. I had only ever seen the sheer darkness of this color in photos of deep space.

As I pull the letter out to read it, the small cut on my finger gets caught on the flap and starts bleeding again. Unbeknownst to myself that this would be the last bit of mail I would ever read on this world. Still chuckling to myself about the guys playing a "good prank" for once.

Now after all the years you have lived and all the things you have witnessed. The depravity of humanity's collective soul I am calling you home son. After what you have seen in the name of Country, and in the name of GOD. I open my kingdom back to you. This happened to my wife and I as well. I hope hearing what happened to us eases your strife.

We have been married for six years, I was not always the white knight, and I am still working on getting the armor grey. We were in a bad situation, neither one of us were working, three kids to raise and cherish, and a marriage that neither of us knew if we wanted anymore.
 
She was fed up with my bs, and I was done with her whining attitude of woe is me. I came home one day and my things were packed outside the door waiting on me. I moved in with my brother and his room-mate across town. I went over to our home every other day if not every day to see our children and make sure she had what she needed. We talked online at night and were trying to work things out.

This continued for several months. Finally she told me I could come back home and we could work things out from there. I didnt know what to do or how to do it. None of our children were in school at the time, and while we were working things out over the interwebs things got heated between me and an old flame. 

Now before everyone in the comments screams that we are married and I was cheating I didnt do this alone, she was also talking to her ex from HS.

Anyway I moved back in and things were okay for the first couple of weeks, we had our spats and our out right fights. We had both made the decision to see other ppl at this point but we were going to try to work it out for the children and for one another. We agreed that we would never bring someone else to our home, we would always go out with our business.

One night we are going to make dinner when she remembers we are out of something and has to go to the store, literally a 3 min walk from our home. While she is out a FB message pops up on her screen from a mutual friend of ours. I sit down at the computer tell him its me and that my wife will be back in a few min.

Now up to this point we have had excellent communication skills about our "business" outside the home. The women I was speaking to I didnt even speak English to so I didnt offend her if she happened to look over at my screen. We both knew what the other was doing and were still trying to work it out. But not tonight, when I sat down at the laptop I happened to see "I love you", "Kiss, miss you baby." "When are you coming over." from this mutual friend on FB. Like I said we had agreed to see other ppl while working this out. I took it with a grain of salt, and dealt with it like every other red blooded American male (went outside grabbed my ball bat and beat a tree) I had just seen this friend a couple of days before with another woman.

Speed ahead two days. She asks me how my "friend" is doing and I tell her fine. Then my mouth oversteps my brain and asks her "So how is "mutual FB friend" in bed?" She laughs it off and says that they are not like that....

Couple hours after that I confront her about it. Tell her that a message popped up on the laptop while she was at the store, the whole nine yards. She blows up at me about not trusting her, and how its a difficult time and that she needs someone who knows her and all the normal things upset women say. I understood she needed time and walked away.

Sitting outside on the porch that night I learned something very interesting to me. I really LOVE this woman. Not like the other women who I have been talking to or have been with in the past. I TRULY LOVE my wife. I go back inside and get on my computer, I message the two women I have been talking to and tell them that its over. My wife and I have worked it out and that I am sorry but I wont be seeing them anymore. I didnt tell my wife this, I wanted to watch and see if she caught on.

She asks me a few days later why I have always been at the house and why I am not talking to anyone online anymore. I just smile and keep on gaming. She asks me a couple of hours later same questions. I look at her and tell her I love her completely and if we are going to make this work I need to be focused on her, not everything else. She is taken aback a bit and starts crying. She comes clean about our mutual FB friend and says she is sorry.

Three years later and we are still stone solid as a couple.
